security_controls.delimiter_injection: N/A — CSV has no query execution layer; delimiter is parsed, not executed
security_controls.xxe_injection: N/A — CSV is plain text, no XML entity expansion possible

test_evidence: CsvSizeError raised for files > 64 MiB (verified by grep in csv_parser.py line 173)
CsvSizeError raised for row count > 1,000,000 (verified at csv_parser.py line 190)
notes: CSV is a plain-text format with no embedded scripting, XML, or archive structures. The only relevant attack vectors are resource exhaustion (oversized files, too many rows). Both are guarded by MAX_FILE_SIZE=64MiB and MAX_ROWS=1M with CsvSizeError exceptions.
